---
title: "Without site-url, the site image keeps its declared size"
_quarto:
  render-project: true
  tests:
    html:
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        -
          - '<meta property="og:image" content="mark.jpg">'
          - '<meta property="og:image:height" content="892">'
          - '<meta property="og:image:width" content="1200">'
        - []
---

The declared size describes the site image used by this page.
